title: Skill-SP bootstrap recovery currently changes generation responsibility, not an identified self-evolution reproduction threshold
dead_end_scope: The standalone claim that Skill Self-Play's reported recovery of initially misaligned models, failure of unguided logical self-play to bootstrap, or large Ministral gains already identify a new self-evolution reproduction-threshold/phase-transition mechanism.

fresh_phenomenon_closure.closure_scope: bootstrap/stagnation and misaligned-model recovery evidence only; does not close separate routing, online-evolution, or taxonomy phenomena

counter_explanation.statement: The reported bootstrap contrast does not hold generation information and computation responsibility fixed. In the released author implementation, unguided logical generation requires the LLM itself to emit a complete hidden solution plus constraints and the repository only validates that object. Skill-guided generation instead asks the LLM for a semantic blueprint, after which package-specific compiler resources sample the hidden solution, construct true clues, render the puzzle, and verify uniqueness. The initial skill library is itself constructed from domain-level task formats and verifier interfaces and contains reusable construction/compiler resources. Therefore the observed valid-task-yield recovery is already predicted by ordinary model-scaffold compatibility, structured program synthesis, rejection-yield/curriculum coverage, and recursive self-training-collapse accounts when one arm offloads constraint construction to deterministic scaffolding. The current evidence cannot identify an additional self-evolution reproduction threshold beyond those mature objects.
counter_explanation.opposite_prediction: Holding backbone and proposal count fixed while moving hidden-solution construction, true-clue construction, and uniqueness enforcement from the LLM into a deterministic compiler should sharply raise accepted valid-task yield even without any new self-evolution phase-transition law. Conversely, sufficiently capable end-to-end proposers can reduce the gap. Thus yield extinction/recovery should track how much structural generation responsibility and verifier-compatible computation the scaffold absorbs, unless a future information- and computation-matched comparison leaves a residual.
counter_explanation.opposite_principle: A self-play loop cannot be diagnosed as subcritical from unequal proposal interfaces: accepted learning-signal yield depends on the information and constraint-satisfaction computation allocated to the proposer versus its scaffold.
counter_explanation.opposite_search_seed: Search only for a same-information, same-computation comparison in which both arms receive the same domain/verifier rules, the same compiler/constraint-satisfaction budget, the same output responsibility, the same proposal and validation budget, and the same frozen learner; then test whether a self-evolution-specific state variable still predicts extinction versus sustained production of independently valid frontier tasks. Do not reopen from another large endpoint gain or from an unguided arm that must synthesize a harder object than the structured arm.
counter_explanation.scope: Skill Self-Play arXiv:2607.22529v1, released logical-generation implementation and the reported unguided-bootstrap / initially-misaligned-model recovery observations.
alternative_explanations_ruled_out: The contrast is merely endpoint solver capability: the primary paper explicitly attributes stagnation to failure to synthesize valid tasks, but that still does not identify a new threshold because proposal interfaces are unequal.

Both arms receive the same structural assistance: false in the released implementation; unguided output is only validated, while skill mode invokes package compiler resources to create the hidden solution and constraints from a blueprint.

The initial skills are information-free labels: false; the paper says they are built from domain-level task formats and verifier interfaces, and the packages contain reusable generation/compiler resources.

A large Ministral gain itself proves a phase transition: endpoint gain is compatible with ordinary scaffold-assisted data generation followed by training, so magnitude alone cannot identify the mechanism.
counter_explanation.reopen_condition: Reopen only if a preregistered comparison equalizes domain/verifier information, compiler/constraint-satisfaction computation, output responsibility, proposal count, validation/rejection budget, learner snapshot, and decoding, yet exhibits a reproducible ex-ante extinction-versus-sustained-learning-signal boundary that the strongest recursive-self-training-collapse, curriculum-coverage/active-learning, rejection-yield, and model-scaffold-compatibility baselines cannot predict. The comparison must measure independently valid frontier-task reproduction before using downstream training gains as evidence.

do_not_say: self-play has no bootstrap threshold in general
structured skills cannot enable weak models
all curriculum effects reduce to prompt engineering
scientific_interpretation.safe_claim: Skill-SP provides strong evidence that structured scaffolding can rescue self-play data generation, but its released unguided-versus-skill logical-generation contrast changes who performs the hard constraint-construction computation; therefore the current observation does not identify a standalone self-evolution reproduction-threshold mechanism.
